results.title: Camera
results.overview: Oscar, a nine-year-old boy who is unable to speak, struggles to adapt in the small fishing town he has just moved to with his widowed, hard-working mother Evelyn. Because of a broken film format camera, an unlikely friendship develops between Oscar and kindly workshop owner Eric.

results.title: Country Dogs
results.overview: This is a short comedy that treads the fine line between humor and absurdity, exploring themes of freedom, fate, and the unexpected mentors we find in the most unlikely places.

results.title: Discord
results.overview: At a young girl's first lesson with a new piano teacher tensions rise to an unexpected climax.

results.title: Gone Fishin'
results.overview: A man happens upon the suicide of an acquaintance, as well as his less-than sincere suicide note drafts.

results.title: Boxer
results.overview: With only his wife by his side, a promising young boxer flees communist Poland to chase his dream of becoming the greatest fighter in history.

results.title: Vegan
results.overview: A vegan social media influencer goes on a quest to document the search for her biological parents. Her search leads her to a defunct, secluded farm where she encounters The Farmer, and her worst nightmares become reality.

results.title: You'll Never Find Me
results.overview: Patrick, a strange and lonely resident, lives in a mobile home at the back of an isolated caravan park. After a violent thunderstorm erupts, a mysterious young woman appears at his door, seeking shelter from the weather. The longer the night wears on and the more the young woman discovers about Patrick, the more difficult she finds it to leave. Soon she begins to question Patrick’s intentions, while Patrick begins to question his own grip on reality...

results.title: Baby Assassins 3
results.original_title: ベイビーわるきゅーれ ナイスデイズ
results.overview: Teenage assassins Mahiro and Chisato visit the coastal city of Miyazaki for a contract and a vacation, but they unexpectedly cross paths with a legendary, bloodthirsty assassin looking to add to his kill count.

results.title: Girl Crush
results.overview: "Girl Crush" follows Jessie, a 24-year-old aspiring musician stuck in a rut at a local indie cinema, grappling with writer's block. Her world takes a turn when she's assigned to mentor Brianna James, a local indie musician and Jessie's idol. Guiding Brianna sparks newfound purpose, breaking Jessie's writer's block. But as lines blur, Jessie realises her feelings go beyond fandom – she's crushing for Brianna. Adding a whimsical touch, Jessie can't stop hearing music in her head, offering a humorous insight into her thoughts. This queer musical rom-com series explores Jessie's journey of discovering bisexuality against the backdrop of the indie music scene.

results.title: Blue Rock
results.overview: Gevano and Pelle were best friends when they were boys, but then they lost track of one another, years later, they finally meet again in prison. While initially it's a happy reunion fondly sharing joyful childhood memories, we slowly learn why they lost touch. Lasse Jonas Rogie’s Blue Rock is a small drama with big emotions that touch on identity and stereotypes on the streets of Rotterdam.

results.title: I Live Where You Vacation, El Árbol de la Vida Vol. I. Samaná
results.original_title: I Live Where You Vacation, El Árbol de la Vida Vol. I. Samaná

results.title: Frogman
results.overview: An amateur filmmaker, struggling to turn his passion into a career, returns with friends to Loveland, Ohio, the location of his first, notorious sighting of the Frogman, determined to obtain irrefutable proof that the cryptid legend exists.

results.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
results.overview: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that—according to legend—will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold. But Mindy meets a mountain man that warns her the treasure is part of an ancient curse—if they remove the gold, they'll destroy the beautiful forest.

results.title: Incision
results.overview: The story follows medical resident London Pierce, played by Brandee Evans, who assumes a new identity to infiltrate an illegal organ harvesting ring after uncovering the truth about her sister Crystal's death. As she navigates the criminal underworld and evades a hitman, Pierce aims to dismantle the operation and save her community.

results.title: My Wife's Ex
results.overview: The events of the film take place in a social and comedic context, where the psychiatrist Youssef is responsible for issuing a psychological report on the dangerous criminal Taha until he is released from prison, and he discovers that he is the ex-husband of his wife Sahar and the father of her son.

results.title: El Barnaverso
results.overview: In a not-so-alternative universe, a series of advertisements promote the beauty of living in idyllic Barcelona while exploring the futility, vanity, and madness of our absurd times.

results.title: Beware the Boogeyman
results.overview: For her first day of orientation, Dr. Tristian Mackenzie makes her way to the Silverdale Psychiatric Hospital for the criminally insane, where she learns of the strange series of cases from the similarly strange Dr. Moon.

results.title: Defect
results.overview: During a service call in the Dutch countryside, a pair of delivery men must confront Eldritchian horrors while fixing a washing machine.

results.title: Kamen Rider Gotchard: The Future Daybreak
results.original_title: 仮面ライダーガッチャード ザ・フューチャー・デイブレイク
results.overview: Houtaro and friends are suddenly attacked by Glion. As they struggle against enemies that appear one after another from a space-time gate, they discover that enemies have been sent from the future! To protect the present and the future, Houtaro and Rinne travel through time and space to the devastated future. Thus the final battle, with everything on the line, finally begins!
